inlines.v: TE'DIOUSNES, noun Wearisomeness by length of continuance or by prolixity; as the tediousness of an oration or argument. 1. Prolixity; length. 2. Tiresomeness; quality of wearying; as the tediousness of delay. 3. Slowness that wearies.
